dossier.purpose: Open-source agent-memory server (Vectorize, v0.10.2): Python/FastAPI over PostgreSQL+pgvector (embedded pg0 by default; Oracle 23ai optional). An LLM extracts facts and entities on retain; recall and reflect are served over REST, a built-in MCP endpoint and SDKs (README.md:24,303,399; hindsight-api-slim/pyproject.toml:177-181). A separate npm package, @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents 0.7.0, merges hooks plus a stdio MCP server into Claude Code, Codex CLI and 17 other agents; by default all wired agents share one bank per git repo (hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/README.md:3-7,898-899; src/core/bank.ts:53). Memory lives in Hindsight Cloud (the default), a self-hosted server, or a local hindsight-embed daemon (coding-agents/README.md:380-401). The older per-agent Claude Code and Codex plugins in the same repo are marked superseded (hindsight-docs/docs-integrations/claude-code.md:9-14).

claims.claim: Coding agents: a per-repo bank built automatically from git history and past sessions, injected at session start, plus curated knowledge pages. 'npx @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents install all' wires every detected agent; 'Ingestion is automatic - there is no setup command'. Top-level README lists 13 agents incl. Claude Code and Codex CLI (package README lists 19).

Claude Code gets 3 hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json, MCP via 'claude mcp add' (user scope) and a companion skill. Codex gets 3 hooks in ~/.codex/hooks.json plus [mcp_servers] in config.toml (needs codex_hooks = true).
Default bank template coding-agent::{gitProject} is harness-neutral: Claude Code, Codex and opencode share one memory per repo.

install is idempotent, preserves existing config, backs up touched files as <file>.hindsight-backup; uninstall removes only its own entries; autoUpdate (default on) re-stages a newer runtime from npm daily.
Three server modes chosen once: cloud (default, needs an API token), self-hosted, daemon (local hindsight-embed on 127.0.0.1:9077; needs uv and an LLM key; macOS also needs a Rust toolchain).
Scoping is one file, ~/.hindsight/coding-agent.json: optInOnly/optInPaths, banks.<id> overrides (disabled, rename), mapPathToBank, paths.<prefix>; no repo-carried config by design.
Every document carries provenance tags source:, harness:<id>, knowledge:<kind> plus configurable retainTags and retainMetadata.
Reset = delete the bank on the server: 'The bank is the only state this integration keeps ... no client-side files to clean up'.
Every server ships a built-in MCP endpoint per bank at /mcp/{bank_id}/, enabled by default.
Memory Defense is an opt-in per-bank scan of retain content for secrets/PII (45 patterns) that redacts or blocks. Banks are isolated: 'no cross-bank leakage'.
State of the art on LongMemEval (94.6% in the chart), 'independently reproduced' by Virginia Tech and The Washington Post collaborators; other scores self-reported by vendors.

integrations.claude_code_or_codex: yes - current path is @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents. Claude Code: 3 hooks (SessionStart 30s, UserPromptSubmit 30s, Stop 60s) in ~/.claude/settings.json, 'claude mcp add --scope user hindsight', skill in ~/.claude/skills. Codex: 3 hooks in ~/.codex/hooks.json, [mcp_servers.hindsight] in ~/.codex/config.toml, [features] hooks = true, skill in ~/.agents/skills (src/installer.ts:568-626,648-710; src/harness/hook-lifecycle.ts:238-270; src/core/skill-dirs.ts:19-21). readme.telemetry_and_network: No product telemetry or phone-home found in server code: a case-insensitive grep of hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api for telemetry/analytics/posthog/sentry/mixpanel hits only OpenTelemetry, and engine/providers/github_copilot_llm.py:455 sets enable_session_telemetry=False. OTLP tracing is off by default (config.py:1956); /metrics is served locally (api/http.py:4962-4971,5565). LLM request tracing is ON by default and stores full prompts and outputs in the local DB for 1 day (config.py:1984-1987; hindsight-docs/docs/developer/configuration.mdx:2549-2551); audit log is OFF by default, retention keep-forever (config.py:1974-1976). Required network: an LLM provider for extraction (default provider openai, config.py:1091); local embeddings/reranker download Hugging Face models on first use (config.py:1211-1212,1273-1275). coding-agents: with no explicit server it defaults to Hindsight Cloud https://api.hindsight.vectorize.io, which needs an account token (src/core/config.ts:584-597; src/installer.ts:1055-1078); it sends session transcripts and commit messages (diffs if gitIngest=full) to the configured server (coding-agents/README.md:571,575). Auto-update (default on) runs npm view daily at session start and spawns a detached 'npx -y @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents@<ver> update' (src/core/auto-update.ts:58-61,293,410-418). Daemon mode fetches hindsight-api via uvx from PyPI (src/core/daemon.ts:1-38). A cold repo triggers a headless claude -p or codex exec survey under the user's own agent account (src/core/survey.ts:201-259). The docs site loads Umami only if UMAMI_URL is set at build (hindsight-docs/docusaurus.config.ts:5-6,82-88); the README embeds a tracking pixel (README.md:442).

code.architecture: Monorepo (CLAUDE.md:107-123). Server hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api: engine/memory_engine.py orchestrates retain/recall/reflect; engine/retain/ (fact_extraction.py, orchestrator.py), engine/search/ (retrieval, fusion, reranking), engine/consolidation/, engine/llm_wrapper.py + providers/ (30 provider ids, config.py:1094-1125), engine/embeddings.py, engine/cross_encoder.py, engine/memories/pg/writes.py (Postgres store with a reversible curation archive for invalidated facts), engine/transfer/ (bank export/import/clone ZIPs), engine/audit.py, engine/llm_trace.py; api/http.py (FastAPI REST, 10k+ lines) and api/mcp.py + mcp_tools.py (39 MCP tools); extensions/ (API-key tenant auth, operation validators, memory_defense.py); config.py (env -> tenant -> bank config); pg0.py; alembic/versions (110 files, auto-run at startup, config.py:1785). Agent layer hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src: installer.ts, harness/hook-lifecycle.ts, core/config.ts, core/bank.ts (bank per git repo, worktree-aware, repo basename only), core/session-start.ts + seed.ts + survey.ts + history.ts, core/retain-hook.ts + transcript*.ts, core/inject.ts, core/knowledge-tools.ts, core/daemon.ts, core/auto-update.ts. Memory content lives only in the bank; the client keeps config, logs and temp caches.
code.packaging_and_release: Python: six wheels/sdists (client, api-slim, api, all, all-slim, embed) built with uv and published to PyPI via trusted publishing on v* tags, with wheel license checks (.github/workflows/release.yml:9-120). npm: TS client, hindsight-all-npm and control plane published with NPM_TOKEN, no --provenance (release.yml:136-294). Rust CLI binaries for linux/darwin amd64+arm64 attached to the GitHub release with LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt; no checksum or signature files (release.yml:296-374,621-649); get-cli installs the latest binary unverified (hindsight-docs/static/get-cli:101-141). Docker images (full and -slim; linux/amd64+arm64) are pushed to ghcr.io, cosign-signed keyless and verified in the job (release.yml:376-519; sign-images.yml; verify command in hindsight-docs/docs/developer/installation.md:163-171); Helm chart to GHCR OCI (release.yml:521-552); GitHub release created as draft then published (release.yml:651-668). Integrations release on integrations/<name>/v* tags; TypeScript ones including coding-agents use 'npm publish --provenance' (release-integration.yml:184-203). Versions: core 0.10.2; coding-agents 0.7.0; Claude Code plugin 0.7.5.

benchmarks.what: Agent Memory Benchmark (AMB) re-run of Hindsight v0.4.19, single-query mode, project harness
Project-built coding-agent suite (61 bug-fix tasks in boltons; deciding context seeded into the bank), memory on vs off, mean of 3 runs
benchmarks.metric: corrections per task; cost; wall time per task
benchmarks.value: Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5) 0.85 -> 0.36 (-57%), cost -24%, 84.7s -> 75.1s; opencode (Gemini 3.5 Flash) 1.20 -> 0.80, cost -13%; Codex CLI (GPT-5.4 mini) 1.34 -> 0.47 (-65%), cost -52%, 53.6s -> 48.6s; solve rate 99-100% in both arms; an earlier per-prompt recall design scored 1.06 vs 0.97 with no memory

risks: Data egress default: absent --server the installer only logs that it is defaulting to Hindsight Cloud (hindsight-integrations/coding-agents/src/installer.ts:1055-1060) and the runtime resolves cloud mode to https://api.hindsight.vectorize.io (src/core/config.ts:584-597). The configured server receives session transcripts, commit messages (diffs if gitIngest=full) and survey findings (coding-agents/README.md:571,575).

No secret/PII scrubbing by default: Memory Defense is a per-bank server policy, default off, never set by the plugin, and affects future retains only (hindsight-docs/docs/developer/memory-defense/index.md:7,15,45-47); LLM request tracing is on by default and keeps full prompts and outputs for 1 day (hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/config.py:1984-1987); the audit log is off by default (config.py:1974).

Deletes are hard and recovery is operator-driven: document, bank and clear-memories deletes are stated as not undoable (api/http.py:7942-7947,8459-8460,10278); only per-fact invalidation is reversible (engine/memories/pg/writes.py:416-526). Recovery needs an export or backup taken earlier (transfer ZIPs, http.py:8830-9018; hindsight-admin restore truncates all tables, admin/cli.py:433-438); the OSS server has no scheduled backup. After a bank delete the next session re-seeds from git and re-surveys (coding-agents/README.md:1090-1092).

Exposure defaults: the server binds 0.0.0.0:8888 (config.py:1500-1501; daemon mode forces 127.0.0.1, main.py:128-136); MCP is on and documented as open until an API-key tenant extension is configured (hindsight-docs/docs/developer/mcp-server.md:30-37; extensions/tenant.py:56-66); the control plane is open unless HINDSIGHT_CP_ACCESS_KEY is set (installation.md:286-288).

Moving target for Claude Code and Codex: the per-agent plugins are superseded, no longer developed and print a deprecation notice every session (hindsight-integrations/claude-code/scripts/lib/upgrade_notice.py:21-35); the new installer does not remove them, so both can run and recall/retain twice into different banks (coding-agents/src/core/legacy.ts:30-36; coding-agents/README.md:348-352). The replacement (0.7.0) auto-updates its runtime daily by default (src/core/auto-update.ts:1-36; config.ts:683). Its package.json declares no license and the directory has no LICENSE file, while the repo is MIT (LICENSE:1-21) and hindsight-control-plane/package.json:32 says ISC.

Platform and footprint: macOS daemon mode needs a Rust toolchain and litellm is pinned <1.92 on darwin (hindsight-api-slim/pyproject.toml:78-88); Intel Macs get the slim bundle only (installation.md:17); WSL2 is undocumented; the full image is about 9 GB and needs 1.5-2 GB RAM (installation.md:57,119); daemon mode needs uv plus an LLM key. Large dependency tree with a yanked-litellm supply-chain note (pyproject.toml:70-72).

Release and CI gaps: CLI binaries ship without checksums or signatures and get-cli does not verify them (.github/workflows/release.yml:621-649; hindsight-docs/static/get-cli:101-141); core npm publishes lack --provenance (release.yml:157-172); legacy get-codex fetches hook scripts from the main branch at install time (hindsight-docs/static/get-codex:67,196-199); the CLI Cargo.lock is gitignored. CI never runs the real-agent e2e for Claude Code/Codex, and test-api needs secrets so fork PRs only get the stub-backed suite (test.yml:1851-1855,3520-3523).

Capture fidelity and cost: facts are LLM-extracted (retainExtractionMode default concise, coding-agents/src/core/config.ts:618-620); the first prompt triggers a reflect synthesis injected into context (20 s timeout, config.ts:483) and the code records an earlier incident of reflect fusing unrelated history into a confabulated imperative narrative (src/core/inject.ts:3-9); pages refresh hourly by default and a cold repo runs a headless survey (Claude capped at USD 2, config.ts:654-656). Daemon mode falls back to the Claude Code CLI provider, which its docs limit to personal local use (src/core/daemon.ts:147-149; hindsight-docs/docs/developer/models.mdx:545-546). No handoff feature was found by grep; closest are session write-back, hindsight_capture_initiative and hindsight_ingest_document.
